label: hook_session_start_startup
source: HAND-AUTHORED AND UNOBSERVABLE: never recorded, and it cannot be. The real SDK never invokes an SDK-callback SessionStart hook for 'startup' (or 'resume') in a streaming-input query() session — anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript#465, confirmed on SDK 0.3.258, 0.3.273 and 0.3.280 (#98) — so no run, fresh session or not, produces this input. Built from SessionStartHookInput's declared shape (sdk.d.ts), mirroring hook_session_start_compact.json's field set with source:'startup' and an obviously-placeholder prompt_id. Its only use is to drive the #465 tripwire test in tests/unit/agent/hooks/boot-bundle.test.ts; it is not evidence that the callback fires. If #465 is fixed upstream, replace it with a recorded input.
